tweaks.title: Set 24-Hour Clock
tweaks.description: Changes clock to display 24-hour format.

tweaks.title: Align Taskbar Left
tweaks.description: Aligns the taskbar to the left side of the screen.

tweaks.title: Detailed BSOD
tweaks.description: Adds detailed information to the Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) screen

tweaks.title: Disable Background MS Store apps
tweaks.description: Disables Microsoft Store apps from running in the background

tweaks.title: Disable Consumer Features
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows from automatically installing games, third-party apps, or app links from the Microsoft Store.

tweaks.title: Disable Copilot
tweaks.description: Removes Microsoft's Copilot feature. (will fail if copilot is not installed)

tweaks.title: Disable Core Isolation
tweaks.description: Disables Core Isolation Memory Integrity to improve system performance

tweaks.title: Disable Dynamic Ticking
tweaks.description: Improves system responsiveness and reduces latency by disabling dynamic timer ticks.

tweaks.title: Disable Fast Startup
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Fast Startup to improve system stability

tweaks.title: Disable Gamebar
tweaks.description: Disables The Xbox gamebar

tweaks.title: Disable Hibernation
tweaks.description: Disables the hibernation feature to free up disk space and improve shutdown speed

tweaks.title: Disable Location Tracking
tweaks.description: Disables Windows location tracking.

tweaks.title: Disable Lockscreen Tips
tweaks.description: Disables tips on the lockscreen.

tweaks.title: Disable Mouse Acceleration
tweaks.description: Disables mouse acceleration for a more consistent and precise mouse movement experience. Great for gaming

tweaks.title: Disable RDP Warnings for Unsigned Files
tweaks.description: Suppresses Windows security warnings when opening unsigned Remote Desktop (.rdp) files.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Recall
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Recall feature for better privacy.

tweaks.title: Disable Taskbar Search
tweaks.description: Hides the search box from the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Disable Telemetry
tweaks.description: Disables Windows telemetry and data collection for improved privacy and performance.

tweaks.title: Disable Wifi Sense
tweaks.description: Disables Wifi Sense to prevent sharing of Wi-Fi networks with contacts

tweaks.title: Enable Dark Mode
tweaks.description: Enables dark mode for Windows. Great for unactivated systems.

tweaks.title: Enable End Task With Right Click
tweaks.description: Enables the "End Task" option in the taskbar context menu

tweaks.title: Enable Game Mode
tweaks.description: Enables Game Mode on windows

tweaks.title: Enable HAGS
tweaks.description: Enables HAGS (Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling)

tweaks.title: Enable Optimization For Windowed Games
tweaks.description: Enables Optimization For Windowed Games on windows

tweaks.title: Hide Taskview and Widgets
tweaks.description: Hides the Taskview and Widgets buttons on the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Menu Show Delay Zero
tweaks.description: Removes the delay when opening menus.

tweaks.title: Optimize Network Settings
tweaks.description: Changes various Windows settings to improve network latency and speeds.

tweaks.title: Optimize Nvidia Settings
tweaks.description: Changes Nvidia Control Panel settings to improve gaming performance

tweaks.title: Remove Microsoft Edge
tweaks.description: Removes Microsoft Edge from Windows.

tweaks.title: Remove Gaming Apps
tweaks.description: Removes Xbox app, Xbox Game Bar, and Xbox Game Overlay

tweaks.title: Remove Microsoft Bing Integration
tweaks.description: Removes Bing apps and disables Bing web search in Windows Search.

tweaks.title: Remove OneDrive
tweaks.description: Removes OneDrive from the system

tweaks.title: Revert Context Menu
tweaks.description: Reverts the context menu to the default Windows 10 context menu.

tweaks.title: Set PowerShell 7 as Default
tweaks.description: Sets PowerShell 7 as the default profile in Windows Terminal (installs PS7 if missing)

tweaks.title: Set Services to Manual
tweaks.description: Sets various Windows services to Manual startup type to improve performance.

tweaks.title: Set Time To UTC
tweaks.description: Sets the system time to UTC, Great for dual booting

tweaks.title: Set Win32 Priority Separation
tweaks.description: Optimizes foreground app performance by modifying system process priority behavior.

tweaks.title: Show Seconds in Taskbar Clock
tweaks.description: Enables the seconds next to the clock in the taskbar

tweaks.title: Ultimate Performance Power Plan
tweaks.description: Enables And Applies The Windows Ultimate Powerplan for better performance

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Platform Binary Table
tweaks.description: Prevents your computer vendor from executing programs at boot, reducing potential security risks.
